up: Show the first 1000 IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1795116 (Protein arginine N-methyltransferase 5). The target must have target_type 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. For each qualifying activity, return the assay ChEMBL ID, the target type, the NCBI taxonomy ID (tax_id) of the target's organism, the canonical SMILES of the tested compound, the molecule's ChEMBL ID, the standard type (which will be 'IC50'), and the pChEMBL value. Include only rows where the standard relation is '=' (exact) and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by assay ChEMBL ID, and limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays ass ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = a.molregno WHERE td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795116' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
